Decisions
Needs Further Discussion
- Timeline for Finote financial consolidation: The group discussed whether financial consolidation with Finote should start in November or be rushed for the first month's closing, pending Cristhian's confirmation with Victor.
Aligned
- Prioritization of SOP and AI tools: The team aligned to prioritize setting up documentation, SOPs, and AI tools for WhatsApp and the app to handle initial support for Spain.
- Absorption of Spain support volume: The team agreed that the current support team capacity can absorb the low initial trip volume in Spain without hiring a full-time dedicated person at this stage.
- Geographic location for future support: If a support hire is needed in the future for Spain, the position should be located outside of Spain in regions like Argentina or Brazil to optimize costs and time zone differences.
- Rescheduling of meeting to Wednesdays: Rafael agreed to change the recurring meeting schedule to Wednesdays in order to include the Finote team.

Next steps

Details
Spain Support Operations and Current Volume: Dan Rizzo raised the immediate priority of establishing documentation and AI tools within the app and via WhatsApp to handle incoming support. Armando Flores noted that Danny and part of Arthur currently handle inbound support. Volume is low (a couple of trips per day). Armando argued the current support team could absorb this volume without a dedicated full-time employee, while Dan Rizzo expressed concern about service quality if volume spikes. Jaqueline Sanches confirmed all support roles are filled except one open position being replaced with an in-house candidate. Consensus: existing team handles inbound using current capacity, AI tools to filter requests, monitoring volume data.

Staffing Schedule and Salesforce Access for Spain Operations: Seven-hour time difference. Staffing weighted toward US and Mexico hours, lighter in early mornings and late evenings. Coverage until 10-11 PM weekdays, 8-9 PM Saturdays. No weekend volume anticipated (Saturdays possible, not Sundays). Spain uses a unique Salesforce instance; support team access needs confirming. Dan Rizzo to verify Salesforce URL redirection and AI integration with Thiago.

Future Support Hiring Strategy and Location: Armando argued hiring outside Spain is more economical. Jaqueline suggested Argentina or Brazil for time zone. Consensus: SOPs and AI tools first, monitor volume, defer hiring until volume justifies it.

Financial Consolidation and Expense Booking with Finote: Rafael moving the meeting to Wednesdays to include Finote. Cristhian: Finote runs independently this month; consolidation scheduled for November pending Victor's confirmation; expenses booked directly into the entity in NetSuite. Armando noted Spain currently has no management allocation; Cristhian to confirm booking, consolidation and allocation steps with Victor.
